purpose: Teach: 不本意/産出/公国/喘息/仰天/変異/転覆/大麻

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に不本意な異動はさせるな
lines.en: I won't have our people sent to positions they don't want.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Clear articulation on the opening phrase. Slight weight on the final clause—a quiet principle, not a threat. Even breathing throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の原料産出地を確認しております
lines.en: Understood. We're verifying the supply sources for the new product line.
lines.style: Attentive, clipped efficiency. Respectful distance in the tone. Reports the fact cleanly without elaboration. Slight nod in the voice on 'understood.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、欧州公国にも代理店を作れ
lines.en: And I want us establishing distribution partners across Europe.
lines.style: Forward-leaning directive. Crisp on the opening conjunction. Conversational but commanding—this is a decision, not a suggestion. Even pace, eyes-forward delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。喘息社員への配慮を整備しました
lines.en: Yes. We've put accommodations in place for staff with respiratory issues.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact completion. Slight lift on 'accommodations'—evidence of care embedded in procedure. Professional tone, no defensiveness. Efficient closure of the point.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様を仰天させる新製品を出せ
lines.en: Then we need a product that impresses our best clients—something they won't expect.
lines.style: Sharp ambition in the opening. Weight on 'impresses.' Conversational pacing but with underlying intensity. Slight lean toward the future tense—this is a challenge being set.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の変異する流れを注視しております
lines.en: Understood. We're tracking market shifts carefully and staying positioned ahead of them.
lines.style: Steady reassurance. Measured pace—not rushed, but present. Slight emphasis on 'tracking' and 'ahead' to signal active vigilance. Confident without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界の権力構造の転覆を狙え
lines.en: Our goal is to reshape how this industry operates at the structural level.
lines.style: Weighted with gravity. Slow opening on the first clause. Each phrase lands with intent—this is not casual talk. Composed throughout, with quiet steel underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の大麻使用は厳禁としております
lines.en: Yes. We maintain strict protocols—substance use is non-negotiable for our staff.
lines.style: Firm closure. Direct, no softening. Slight hardness on 'strict' and 'non-negotiable'—this is a boundary, stated cleanly. Brief, final, deliberate.
